descriptionByLocale.it:
Eraneos è un gruppo internazionale di strategia, trasformazione e consulenza tecnologica che aiuta le aziende a prosperare in un mondo digitale dinamico. Con esperti di prima classe di business e tecnologia, possiamo dare ai nostri clienti nuovi standard per trasformazioni sostenibili – dalla strategia all'implementazione. Sia nella progettazione di organizzazioni sostenibili, lo sviluppo di nuove potenzialità attraverso dati e AI o la protezione delle aziende attraverso la sicurezza informatica olistica: Consegniamo i risultati in modo pragmatico e mirato. Il nostro team di circa 1.200 dipendenti dedicati è rappresentato in uffici in Svizzera, Germania, Paesi Bassi, Spagna, Danimarca, Svezia, Austria, Regno Unito, Singapore e Stati Uniti e combina prospettive globali con forti radici locali. Circa 450 dipendenti lavorano nelle sedi svizzere di Zurigo, Berna e Losanna. Questo è il lavoro - i compiti principali
• Consulenza strategica a livello interindustriale nell'attuazione di nuovi requisiti normativi (definire i requisiti, effettuare analisi del gap, identificare i campi di azione e attuare misure)
• Consultare i nostri clienti principalmente nelle seguenti aree di diritto: (Gen)AI Governance & Compliance, Diritto Contratto e Licenza, Progettazione Contraente, Diritto Contratto, Protezione dei Dati e Sicurezza Informatica, Gestione del Rischio di Terze Parti, Sicurezza Informatica, Requisiti FINMA, ecc. con particolare attenzione alle questioni relative alla trasformazione digitale
• Assumere la responsabilità nei sottoprogetti e il supporto nella pianificazione, nel controllo e nell'attuazione di progetti complessi per i clienti
• Partecipazione attiva all'espansione del team internazionale di strategia legale
• L'attività del progetto di cross-industry con l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze approfondite in un settore Questo lavoro è per te se
• Hai completato con successo una legge o una laurea in diritto commerciale.
• Ti dispiace. 2 anni di esperienza nell'interfaccia di legge, tecnologia e IT e hanno idealmente già lavorato in digitalizzazione, conformità, protezione dei dati, sicurezza informatica o progetti di trasformazione.
• Siete entusiasti dell'applicazione pratica dei requisiti legali relativi alla tecnologia (ad esempio legge sulla protezione dei dati, sicurezza delle informazioni, cloud, AI).
• Ti piace portare avanti progetti in modo strutturato, assumendo responsabilità e assumendo compiti di project management in futuro.
• Si comunica in modo convincente e strutturato e si ha la capacità di trasmettere concetti e problemi complessi ai gruppi target.
• Si comunica per via orale e per iscritto in modo sicuro in tedesco e inglese (livello C1). Come un i-top si porta con te
• Avvocato brevetto (Svizzera)
• Certificazione o formazione in settori quali la protezione dei dati, la sicurezza delle informazioni, la sicurezza informatica, la gestione dei progetti, la tecnologia legale o la governance dell'AI Il prossimo passo verso un'applicazione di successo
• Annalena come persona di contatto non vede l'ora di ricevere la vostra candidatura diretta tramite il nostro sito web (CV, diplomi e certificati di lavoro in PDF). La diversità è importante per noi – mostraci cosa ti rende e inviaci i tuoi documenti oggi! Le applicazioni via e-mail e da parte dei fornitori di servizi del personale non vengono considerate e eliminate direttamente.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Eraneos is an international strategy, transformation and technology advisory group that helps companies thrive in a dynamic digital world. With first-class experts from business and technology, we empower our customers to set new standards for sustainable transformations – from strategy to implementation. Whether in the design of sustainable organizations, the development of new potential through data and AI or the protection of companies through holistic cybersecurity: We deliver results pragmatically and purposefully. Our team of around 1,200 dedicated employees is represented in offices in Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, the UK, Singapore and the USA and combines global perspectives with strong local roots. Around 450 employees work at the Swiss locations in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne. This is the job - your main tasks
• Strategic cross-industry consultancy in the implementation of new regulatory requirements (define requirements, carry out gap analysis, identify fields of action and implement measures)
• Advising our customers primarily in the following areas of law: (Gen)AI Governance & Compliance, Contract and License Law, Contract Design, Contract Law, Data Protection and Information Security, Third Party Risk Management, Cybersecurity, FINMA requirements, etc. with focus on issues related to digital transformation
• Assuming responsibility in sub-projects as well as support in planning, controlling and implementing complex customer projects
• Active participation in the expansion of the international Legal Strategy Team
• Cross-industry project activity with the opportunity to build up in-depth expertise in an industry This job is for you if
• You have successfully completed a law or business law degree.
• You mind. 2 years of experience at the interface of law, technology and IT and have ideally already worked in digitization, compliance, data protection, cybersecurity or transformation projects.
• You are excited about the practical application of legal requirements related to technology (e.g. data protection law, information security, cloud, AI).
• You enjoy driving forward projects in a structured way, taking on responsibility and taking on project management tasks in the future.
• You communicate convincingly and in a structured manner and you have the ability to convey complex concepts and issues to target groups.
• You communicate orally and in writing safely in German and English (C1 level). As an i-top you bring with you
• Lawyer's patent (Switzerland)
• Certification or training in areas such as data protection, information security, cybersecurity, project management, legal tech or AI governance Your next step towards a successful application
• Annalena as your contact person is looking forward to receiving your direct application via our website (CV, diplomas and employment certificates in PDF). Diversity is important to us – show us what makes you and send us your documents today! Applications by e-mail and by personnel service providers are not considered and deleted directly.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Eraneos ist eine internationale Beratungsgruppe für Strategie, Transformation und Technologie, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, in einer dynamischen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein. Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Massstäbe für nachhaltige Transformationen zu setzen – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet. Unser Team von rund 1‘200 engagierten Mitarbeitenden ist in Büros in der Schweiz, Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, Grossbritannien, Singapur und den USA vertreten und verbindet globale Perspektiven mit starken lokalen Wurzeln. An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 450 Mitarbeitende.

Das ist der Job - Deine Hauptaufgaben

• Strategische Cross-Industry-Beratung bei der Implementierung neuer regulatorischer Vorgaben (Anforderungen definieren, Gap-Analyse durchführen, Handlungsfelder aufzeigen und Massnahmen umsetzen)

• Beratung unserer Kunden vorrangig in folgenden Rechtsgebieten: (Gen)AI Governance & Compliance, Vertrags- und Lizenzrecht, Contract Design, Vertragsrecht, Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit, Third-Party-Risk-Management, Cybersecurity, FINMA-Vorgaben, etc. mit Fokus auf Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit digitaler Transformation

• Übernahme von Verantwortung in Teilprojekten sowie Unterstützung bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte

• Aktive Mitgestaltung beim Ausbau des internationalen Legal Strategy Teams

• Industrieübergreifende Projekttätigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, sich in einer Branche vertiefte Expertise aufzubauen

Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn

• Du erfolgreich ein Studium der Rechtswissenschaften oder Wirtschaftsrecht abgeschlossen hast.

• Du mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Recht, Technologie und IT hast und idealerweise bereits in Digitalisierungs-, Compliance-, Datenschutz-, Cybersecurity- oder Transformationsprojekten mitgearbeitet hast.

• Dich die praktische Anwendung rechtlicher Vorgaben mit technologischem Bezug (z. B. Datenschutzrecht, Informationssicherheit, Cloud, KI) begeistert.

• Du Freude daran hast, Projekte strukturiert voranzutreiben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und perspektivisch Projektleitungsaufgaben zu übernehmen.

• Du überzeugend und strukturiert kommunizierst und du die Gabe hast, komplexe Konzepte und Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.

• Du mündlich und schriftlich sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizierst (C1-Niveau).

Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit

• Anwaltspatent (Schweiz)

• Zertifizierungen oder Weiterbildungen in Bereichen wie Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Cybersecurity, Projektmanagement, Legal Tech oder AI Governance

Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung

• Annalena als deine Ansprechperson freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (Lebenslauf, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse in PDF).

Diversity wird bei uns grossgeschrieben – zeig uns, was dich ausmacht und schick uns deine Unterlagen noch heute!

Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie von Personaldienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt und direkt gelöscht.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Que ce soit dans la conception d'organisations durables, le développement de nouveaux potentiels par les données et l'IA ou la protection des entreprises par la cybersécurité holistique: Nous obtenons des résultats pragmatiquement et délibérément. Notre équipe d'environ 1 200 employés dévoués est représentée dans des bureaux en Suisse, en Allemagne, aux Pays-Bas, en Espagne, au Danemark, en Suède, en Autriche, au Royaume-Uni, à Singapour et aux États-Unis. Environ 450 employés travaillent dans les locaux suisses de Zurich, Berne et Lausanne. C'est le travail - vos principales tâches
• Conseils stratégiques intersectoriels dans la mise en œuvre de nouvelles exigences réglementaires (définir les exigences, effectuer une analyse des lacunes, identifier les domaines d'action et mettre en œuvre des mesures)
• Conseiller nos clients principalement dans les domaines suivants du droit : (Gen)AI Gouvernance et conformité, Droit des contrats et des licences, Conception des contrats, Droit des contrats, Protection des données et sécurité de l'information, Gestion des risques de tiers, Cybersécurité, exigences FINMA, etc., en mettant l'accent sur les questions liées à la transformation numérique
• Prise en charge des sous-projets et appui à la planification, au contrôle et à la mise en œuvre de projets clients complexes
• Participation active à l ' élargissement de l ' Équipe de la Stratégie juridique internationale
• Activité de projet transindustriel avec l'occasion de développer une expertise approfondie dans une industrie Ce travail est pour vous si
• Vous avez réussi un diplôme en droit ou en droit des affaires.
• Ça vous dérange. Deux ans d'expérience à l'interface du droit, de la technologie et de l'informatique et ont idéalement déjà travaillé dans des projets de numérisation, de conformité, de protection des données, de cybersécurité ou de transformation.
• Vous êtes heureux de l'application pratique des exigences légales liées à la technologie (par exemple, la loi sur la protection des données, la sécurité de l'information, le cloud, l'IA).
• Vous aimez faire avancer les projets de manière structurée, prendre des responsabilités et assumer des tâches de gestion de projet à l'avenir.
• Vous communiquez de manière convaincante et structurée et vous avez la capacité de transmettre des concepts et des questions complexes aux groupes cibles.
• Vous communiquez oralement et par écrit en toute sécurité en allemand et en anglais (niveau C1). Comme un i-top que tu amènes avec toi
• Brevet d'avocat (Suisse)
• Certification ou formation dans des domaines tels que la protection des données, la sécurité de l'information, la cybersécurité, la gestion de projets, la technologie juridique ou la gouvernance de l'IA Votre prochaine étape vers une application réussie
• Annalena comme votre personne-ressource est impatiente de recevoir votre demande directe via notre site Web (CV, diplômes et certificats d'emploi en PDF). La diversité est importante pour nous – montrez-nous ce qui vous fait et envoyez-nous vos documents aujourd'hui! Les demandes par courrier électronique et par les fournisseurs de services au personnel ne sont pas examinées et supprimées directement.

• esperienza di lavoro in ambienti di consulenza svizzera

descriptionByLocale.en:
Eraneos is an international management and technology consulting group that helps organisations thrive in an increasingly dynamic digital world. With first-class experts from business and technology, we empower our clients to set new standards for sustainable transformation – from strategy to execution. Whether shaping future-ready organisations, unlocking new potential through data and AI, or strengthening businesses through holistic cybersecurity, we deliver results in a pragmatic and targeted way.
Our team of around 1,200 dedicated professionals is based in offices across Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, the United Kingdom, Singapore and the USA, combining global perspectives with strong local roots. Around 460 employees work across our Swiss offices in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne.
In the Romandie market, this role sits at the intersection of client impact, market development and leadership. The focus is on building senior-level relationships, shaping transformative AI and Data agendas and turning strategic opportunities into meaningful consulting mandates with lasting business value.

That’s the job – your main tasks

• Driving business development and sales activities for AI and Data consulting engagements across the Romandie market, with a clear focus on growth, relevance and client impact

• Building trusted advisor relationships with C-level stakeholders and positioning AI as a strategic lever for business transformation, operating model evolution and competitive advantage

• Identifying, shaping and winning complex AI and Data opportunities, from early client dialogue through proposal development to mandate launch

• Leading high-impact consulting engagements from strategy through implementation oversight, while connecting AI initiatives with broader business and organisational transformation programmes

• Contributing to the growth of the local Data & AI practice through mentoring, team development, market visibility and close collaboration with Eraneos experts across Switzerland and Europe

This job is for you, if …

• extensive experience in consulting, business transformation and AI/Data advisory is combined with the seniority required to operate credibly at executive level

• a strong track record in selling, developing and leading consulting engagements related to AI, GenAI, Data or digital transformation can be demonstrated

• senior stakeholders can be engaged with confidence and AI can be positioned not as a trend topic, but as a concrete business and transformation agenda

• large-scale transformation initiatives have been shaped or led in complex environments, ideally with clear ownership for outcomes, stakeholder alignment and delivery quality

• strong expertise across current AI trends, LLM ecosystems, GenAI use cases and enterprise adoption challenges is complemented by fluent French at a minimum C1 level and professional English proficiency

As the icing on the cake, you bring along …

• experience in Public Sector, Utilities, Transport or other regulated industries

• an existing network in the Swiss Romandie market

• experience working in Swiss consulting environments

• a visible entrepreneurial mindset paired with strong ownership and market-building ambition

• the credibility and drive to help expand a high-performing AI & Data presence in Romandie

Even if not every requirement is fully met, we would still be very glad to receive your application.

Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung

• Hüseyin as your contact person is looking forward to receiving your direct application via our website
(CV, diplomas and references in PDF format).

Diversity matters deeply to us – show us what makes you unique and send us your application today.

* Applications by e-mail or from recruitment agencies will not be considered and will be deleted.
